scripts.dev: bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/search-api build && VITE_API_DOCS=1 bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/web dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/search-api build && bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/web build
scripts.deploy: bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/search-api build && bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/web deploy
scripts.test: bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/web test && bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/search-api test && bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/admin-api test && bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/crawler test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/web typecheck && bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/admin-api typecheck && bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/crawler typecheck
scripts.gen: bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/shared gen && bun run --filter @taiwanhaul/search-api gen
